thread:
emma: Quick note — Next middleware hanging in prod when using default SDK import. Repro on Vercel Edge.

raj: Same here. Switched to explicit edge entry and it fixed the hang: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/edge'`.

paul: FYI the root cause seems to be node-only retry/timer code getting bundled. Edge needs AbortController-based timeouts.

emma: Can we add a tiny example and a README blurb so folks don't hit this? I wasted ~2 hours.

edge-bot: Created issue sdk#478 (edge-export + abort-retry).

raj: I'll add a short example under examples/next-middleware-edge and a CI smoke test against Vercel CLI.

paul: Also add an `exports` edge conditional so SWC picks the right file.

emma: Thanks — please ping here when canary is up and I'll retest.
